test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following sports has Oinam Bembem Devi represented India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Football.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Indian football player **Oinam Bembem Devi was born in **Imphal, Manipur.**
 
• She is actively working to** raise awareness** of **women's football in India** and has earned the moniker** "the Durga of Indian Football."**
 
• She received the **Arjuna Award in 2017 **from the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.**
 
• In** November 2021**, Oinam Bembem Devi became the **first female football player** from India to get the** Padma Shri Award.​**
